cohort: The study included 345 newborns (115 cases and 230 controls) at a tertiary care hospital in Central Ethiopia.
finding: Rural residence, premature rupture of membranes, prolonged labor, noncephalic fetal presentation, instrumental delivery, and cesarean section delivery were identified as independent determinants of birth asphyxia.
mod_finding: Instrumental delivery and cesarean section delivery were identified as independent determinants of birth asphyxia.
